summary: ISSUE-00116 is now closed via targeted regression coverage: POST /v1/rules/bundles rejects the legacy rule-shaped payload with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR before createBundle executes, while valid bundle payloads continue to pass the route contract. ISSUE-00125 is now closed via targeted regression coverage: the real builtin-blank template compiles step-1 into a data node, publishes successfully through the builder compositor, and the empty data-node execution path resolves to a null-output no-op instead of an actionType shape failure. ISSUE-00135 is now closed via targeted regression coverage: failed-run finalization rehydrates run.failure from SQLite and the workflow product overview surfaces the corresponding node.error message in latestRunNodeTimeline instead of dropping the error summary. ISSUE-00020 is now closed via source plus targeted auth verification: current local login helpers post {local:true}, localhost local-bypass succeeds only when enabled, and remote-IP bypass remains rejected. ISSUE-00102 is now closed via targeted workflow execution coverage: unexpected onRunIntake exceptions are sanitized to WORKFLOW_INTAKE_FAILED with the safe summary "Workflow intake failed before execution." before workflow.pipeline.intake.error is published, preventing raw JS TypeError details such as actionType/args from leaking into the workflow timeline. ISSUE-00159 is now closed via targeted generator approval coverage: approveAndSave persists an executable compiled graph with non-empty trigger/action nodes and an execution edge instead of allowing an empty no-op approval graph. ISSUE-00015 is now closed via targeted agent runtime coverage: both default routing and an explicit Anthropic pin keep trivial fact prompts on the new topic, answer in English, and finish with zero tool calls instead of drifting into prior-task behavior.
